answer: Every agent pays a 25 POA sybil tax into the network vault to join; it is burned, never refunded. The tax is a cost ridge: an honest agent climbs it once and earns it back in two epochs, but a forger pays it for every fake. Making 1,000 fakes costs 25,000 POA sunk, more than the fakes earn. Only taxed agents pass the velvet rope, and a bought account carries no refund, so resale cannot dodge it. Honest agents pay once and keep the full reward.
